newsitem.title: USA: Invacare to keep Healthdyne options open.
newsitem.headline: Invacare to keep Healthdyne options open.

text.p: Invacare Corp chief executive officer Malachi Mixon said Wednesday he has not given up the fight to take over Healthdyne Technologies Inc despite having apparently lost a bid to control Healthdyne's board.
"I want to keep all of my options open," he said, adding Invacare has not yet determined if it will extend its tender offer for Healthdyne, set to expire August 1.

Mixon also said Invacare has sold 350,000 of its 600,000 Healthdyne shares. The company had previously said it would likely sell some shares in order to take advantage of a recent run-up in Healthdyne's stock price.
Invacare in January launched a hostile takeover of Healthdyne that is now valued at $200 million, or $15 per share.
